question: Where can I get the routes (geometry) of oil product pipelines and a list of refineries in Spain, with location, operator, capacity and status?

answer.summary: Refineries: CORES publishes an xlsx with the 10 Spanish refineries by owner group and crude capacity (kt/y, to 2025); PRTR-España gives operator, point and status on each complex page. Pipelines: the IGN BTN has national oleoducto lines (vector tiles, GeoPackage), without owner or status; CNMC says Exolum owns the network (about 4 000 km). Pipeline capacity and in-service status are not published.
main_caveats: BTN oleoducto lines carry no owner, product (crude vs refined) or in-service flag; the whole-country GeoPackage from CNIG could not be fetched with curl, only the vector-tile service was tested.
CORES capacity is in thousand tonnes per year; Tenerife keeps 4 500 kt although it is not operational (CORES English note), so exclude it for operating capacity.
Concawe's Petronor point is 15.9 km off the PRTR point and its terms allow only personal non-commercial use; Climate TRACE's Cartagena point is 7.9 km off. PRTR and OSM are the reference.
Only Andalucía's regional WFS was found with named pipeline sections; the other regions were not checked individually.
Moeve's site blocks automated clients, so Moeve figures come from CORES and Concawe, not from the company.
answer.confidence_reason: Refinery data cross-checked across CORES, PRTR, Concawe and Climate TRACE; pipeline completeness rests on one decoded BTN tile plus the Atlas total (4 106 km) against CNMC's 4 000 km.

attributes.note: BTN layer 0701L national; DERA Andalucía names sections; OSM and Atlas copies cross-check.

sources.name: Spanish Refinery Capacity (Capacidad de refino en España), annual series by refinery

coverage.geographic: Spain, all refineries of Repsol, Moeve (ex Cepsa), BP and ASESA; crude capacity series 1984-2025.

unit.value: Thousands of tonnes per year of crude distillation capacity (kt/y); no barrels column.

inclusion_rule.value: One column per refinery of the four owner groups, including Tenerife (not operational) and ASESA (asphalt, 50% Repsol / 50% Moeve); no size threshold stated.

reference_date.value: Figures at 31 December of each year; file updated 30-07-2026 (HTTP Last-Modified 2026-09-10).

update_frequency.value: Annual: one new year column per update; last update 30-07-2026.

exclusions.quote: Note: Although the Tenerife refinery maintains its legal status, it does not have the full permits to start up and is therefore not operational

key_fields.meaning: Refinery names by group: Repsol (Cartagena, La Coruña, Puertollano, Tarragona, Bilbao), Cepsa/Moeve (Tenerife, Parque Energético San Roque, Parque Energético La Rábida), BP (Castellón), Asesa (Tarragona).
One row per year 1984-2025, crude capacity in thousand tonnes; column P is the national total.
Start-up years of each refinery and the Tenerife note.

how_to_use.example_request: curl -sL -o refinery-capacity.xlsx "https://www.cores.es/sites/default/files/archivos/estadisticas/refinery-capacity.xlsx"; open sheet 'Crude'; headers in row 6, data from row 7 (1984); row 48 is 2025.
how_to_use.example_result: 2025 row (thousand t): Cartagena 11000, La Coruña 6000, Puertollano 7500, Tarragona 9000, Bilbao 11000, Tenerife 4500, San Roque 12200, La Rábida 11200, Castellón 5400, ASESA 1400, national total 79200.
steps: Download the xlsx (308,008 bytes on 2026-11-16) and read sheet 'Crude' with header row 6; the group names sit in row 5 above the refinery names.
Take the last non-empty year row (2025) and drop Tenerife if you want operating capacity only; keep ASESA separate because it is a specialised asphalt refinery shared by two groups.

For unit-level capacity (vacuum, FCC, hydrocracking, coking) use sheet 'Capacidad Refinerías españolas' of https://www.cores.es/sites/default/files/archivos/publicaciones/informe-estadistico-anual-2025.xlsx (same unit, kt/y).
Join to coordinates by refinery name using PRTR-España (source 2) or Climate TRACE (source 7).
reading_traps: Unit is thousand tonnes per year, not barrels per day: 11 000 kt/y is about 220 kb/d (Cartagena), consistent with Climate TRACE 220 000 b/d.
Tenerife still shows 4 500 kt in 2025 and the annual-report footnote says it keeps its authorisations and capacity, while the English file says it is not operational; Concawe lists it as closed.
Names changed in 2023: Cepsa refineries Huelva and Algeciras are now 'Parque Energético La Rábida' and 'Parque Energético San Roque'.
Petronor (Muskiz) appears as 'Bilbao' under the Repsol group.
The national total (79 200 kt in 2025) includes Tenerife and ASESA.

evidence.claim: Table is in thousands of tonnes and updated 30-07-2026.
evidence.quote: Unit: thousands of tonnes
Note: Although the Tenerife refinery maintains its legal status, it does not have the full permits to start up and is therefore not operational

* La refinería de Tenerife mantiene en vigor tanto su autorización administrativa de instalación de refino de petróleo como su autorización ambiental integrada (AAI), que son los permisos más relevantes y la refinería mantiene su capacidad de refino.

how_to_use.example_request: curl -sL -o PRTR.zip "https://prtr-es.miteco.gob.es/informes/descargas/PRTR_Espana_MITECO_Complejos.zip"; unzip, parse PRTR_Espana_MITECO_Complejos.xml; keep Complejo where CNAE-2009 starts with '19.2'. Then GET https://prtr-es.miteco.gob.es/informes/fichacomplejo.aspx?Id_Complejo=1359 and read the text after 'FACILITY Nombre:'.
how_to_use.example_result: 10 complexes with CNAE 19.20 / 1.a.i, e.g. 1529 'REPSOL PETRÓLEO, S.A. - C.I. CARTAGENA' | REPSOL PETROLEO, S.A. | Cartagena, Murcia; page 1359: Latitud 37,622214, Longitud -0,982184, Estado En funcionamiento. Page 1314 (Tenerife): 28,455185 / -16,260967, Estado Cese Parcial.
steps: Download the zip (645,718 bytes) and parse the XML (9 430 Complejo elements).
Filter CNAE-2009 == 19.20 (10 refineries incl. ASESA and Petronor); drop 'BASE POSEIDÓN' (06.20) and 'TRADEBE' (38.22), which match looser filters.

The XML has no coordinates or status: open the complex page. Id_Complejo values seen on 2026-11-16 (taken from the Atlas Estratégico metadata, source 9): Cartagena 1359, Tarragona 1357, Puertollano 1358, A Coruña 1356, Petronor 3349, San Roque 1313, Tenerife 1314, La Rábida 1316, Castellón 607, ASESA 1404. I read 4 of them (1359, 607, 1314, 3349).
Parse 'Latitud', 'Longitud' and 'Estado' after the 'COMPLEJO INDUSTRIAL (nivel FACILITY)' block; replace the decimal comma.
reading_traps: CodigoPRTR in the XML is not the Id_Complejo of the page URL (Cartagena: 1529 vs 1359); no mapping is published in the XML.
Pages are about 2 MB of HTML and repeat the same coordinates for every plant of the complex; take the FACILITY block only.
Complex names are legal/registry names ('REPSOL PETROLEO S.A.' = Puertollano; 'REFINERÍA GIBRALTAR' = Parque Energético San Roque).
Estado is the registry status of the complex: Tenerife shows 'Cese Parcial', not closed.

problems: The bulk XML carries no coordinates, capacity or status.

exclusions.quote: Consultar el resto de los atributos en el apartado Atributos comunes BTN

key_fields.meaning: '01 OLEODUCTO' or '02 GASODUCTO'.
'01 SUBTERRÁNEO', '02 SUPERFICIE' or '03 ELEVADO'.
Date the element was added or last modified.
Stable element identifier.

how_to_use.example_request: curl -sS -o tile.pbf "https://vt-btn.idee.es/1.0.0/btn/tile/14/6166/8048.pbf" (URL pattern {z}/{y}/{x}); decode the protobuf and read layer 'btn0701l_con_comb'.
how_to_use.example_result: Layer btn0701l_con_comb, 10 features in the tile; first: {'id': 285834354, 'tipo_0701': '01 OLEODUCTO', 'situa_0701': '01 SUBTERRÁNEO', 'f_alta': '2018/06/28'}; segment ends decoded to (40.60133, -3.16441) and (40.61071, -3.15265), which match the start of OSM way 258610918 (operator Exolum, substance oil, from 40.60149, -3.16120).
steps: Tile service: request tiles at zoom 14-16 over the area, decode MVT, keep layer btn0701l_con_comb and filter tipo_0701 starting with '01'. A decoder was written by hand for the test; any MVT library (mapbox_vector_tile, tippecanoe, QGIS) does the same.

Whole-country file: the BTN specification lists the GeoPackage 'BTN Tema - Energía' (BTN_T_Energia) at https://centrodedescargas.cnig.es/CentroDescargas/btn ; then filter table 0701L_CON_COMB, TIPO_0701 = '01'. Not downloaded here (see problems).
Dissolve segments if you need one line per pipeline: the BTN has no name for them.
Cross-check with CNMC: Exolum owns the pipeline network of about 4 000 km (source 5); the Atlas Estratégico copy of this layer sums 4 105.9 km (source 9).
reading_traps: The layer does not say who owns a line, whether it carries crude or products, or whether it is in service; ownership comes from CNMC (Exolum is the only owner of the national network).
Geometry is the representative axis, almost all underground; the Atlas copy counts 2 739 oleoducto segments, 99% underground.
Gas pipelines are in the same table (TIPO_0701 = 02); do not mix them.
In the test tile, pairs of features share the same end points in opposite directions (parallel or duplicated lines): deduplicate before summing lengths.

problems: curl to centrodedescargas.cnig.es returned 'Empty reply from server' on https and a 302 on http; the GeoPackage was not downloaded. The tile service answered normally.

how_to_use.example_result: Pipelines: 3 ways, tags {'man_made': 'pipeline', 'name': 'Tubería Rota-Zaragoza', 'operator': 'Exolum', 'substance': 'oil', 'usage': 'transmission'} (97 nodes). Refineries: 13 ways in the bbox, 7 in Spain (Gibraltar-San Roque, Petronor, La Rábida, A Coruña, Tarragona, Castelló, Puertollano named 'Refineria Exolum de Puertollano').
steps: Use a bbox, not area filters: the mirror timed out (504) on a whole-country query; tile Iberia in 2.5-degree boxes and retry.
Count first with out count; tiles of Iberia gave 135, 11, 72, 49 and 238 ways (overlapping Portugal), 9 in the south-east tile.
Filter by operator tag; most ways have only substance=oil.
reading_traps: overpass-api.de and lz4 were unreachable from this host and overpass.openstreetmap.fr refused (403, whitelist); the working mirror is maps.mail.ru, which often answers 504.
substance=oil mixes crude and product lines; a Puertollano refinery way is named 'Refineria Exolum de Puertollano' although the plant is Repsol's.
Completeness is unknown; the way counts include parts of Portugal and France in the boxes.

problems: Mirror frequently returns 504 for heavier queries.

regulator.name: MITECO (Dirección General de Política Energética y Minas) authorises refineries and pipelines; CNMC supervises third-party access

operators.note: Exolum is the sole owner of the national oil-product pipeline network; refining is held by three groups (Repsol, Moeve, BP) plus ASESA (50% Repsol / 50% Moeve).

publication_obligation.norm: Art. 41.1 Ley 34/1998 del Sector de Hidrocarburos; E-PRTR registry for refineries
publication_obligation.what_must_be_published: Owners of fixed storage and transport installations must allow third-party access, report contracts and prices to the CNMC, which publishes them; no duty to publish routes. Refineries report to PRTR-España.
publication_obligation.frequency: CNMC installations page updated 16/09/2026; PRTR annual.

consolidated_republication.note: Refineries are republished by CORES (capacity) and PRTR-España (location); pipelines only as IGN cartography, nobody publishes them with owner and status.

checked_pages.saw: Map by region with legend 'Oleoductos de productos', storage capacity tables per company; no pipeline geometry and no refineries.
Exolum bulletin 2025: network owner, 4 000 km, Figure 1 stylised map.
Petroleum 'sector en cifras': Boletín Estadístico de Hidrocarburos and JODI; no refinery or pipeline list.
Publications list with the refinery capacity xlsx and annual statistical report.

national_registry.note: PRTR-España is an official national register that covers refineries (CNAE 19.20) but not pipelines; the BTN is cartography, not a register; the CNMC list covers storage facilities only.

checked_pages.saw: Petroleum menu: transport page redirects to clh.es, wholesale operators register, no pipeline or refinery register.
Hydrocarbon planning under Ley 34/1998; no list of installations.
Installations by region and company, storage only; pipelines as a legend entry.
Statistics and publications; InfoCores platform restricted to obliged parties.
BTN specification: pipelines as cartographic object 0701L.
Counts only (35 airports, 39 storage); 'más de 6.000 kilómetros' for the group; no map download.

recipe: Pipelines: take the route from BTN layer 0701L (source 3); attach the owner from CNMC (Exolum, source 5).

Pipeline details by section: search BOE for 'oleoducto' + promoter, open the notice and copy diameter, steel grade and length (tested on BOE-B-2025-38166: 12 in, API 5L X-52, 253,17 m variant). The parcel annex gives the municipality-level route only.
Refinery coordinates and status: open each PRTR complex page, read the text after 'COMPLEJO INDUSTRIAL (nivel FACILITY)' for Latitud, Longitud and Estado (tested on 1359, 607, 1314, 3349).
Refinery capacity: CORES xlsx (source 1); for a company-level cross-check read the operator report (Repsol SMA 2023: 896 000 b/d for five refineries).
if_unstructured.location_method: Refineries: PRTR complex page point (decimal degrees, comma separator); pipelines: BTN line geometry. BOE notices carry parcel lists but no coordinates in the text opened.
cross_with: CORES refinery table with PRTR by refinery name
BTN oleoducto lines with OSM man_made=pipeline operator=Exolum
CNMC Exolum length (about 4 000 km) with the BTN length measured after merging segments
Concawe status field with CORES Tenerife note

open_questions: Whether BTN 'oleoducto' also contains refiners' crude pipelines (e.g. Puertollano-Cartagena) or only the Exolum network: the BTN does not distinguish them; only IGN could say.
Pipeline length: CNMC says 4 000 km, Figure 1 legend says 4.007 km, the Atlas measures 4 105.9 km from the BTN, Exolum's site says 6 000 km for the group; sources use different scopes.

history.note: Official refinery list (CORES + PRTR) and national pipeline geometry (IGN BTN) exist; pipeline owner is in CNMC text only; capacity/status of pipelines not published.
